rationale: This manifest is a protected quality artifact, not scanner configuration. It declares which files are first-class runtime code for the integrity analyzer. It must cover the bundled CLI entry graph, the harness runtime used by cc.cmd/cc.ps1, build tooling, and the quality tooling itself. Widening, narrowing, or exempting a root here is a policy change: it is hashed into policyDigest and invalidates accepted baselines.

roots.proof: Bundled into dist/cli.js from src/entrypoints/cli.tsx by scripts/build.ts (bun build --root=src/entrypoints).
Invoked by package.json scripts and by the cc.cmd -> cc.ps1 -> gateway-supervisor.mjs -> model-gateway.mjs chain.
